registryEvidence.basis: Tamil Nadu Government land-record e-services explicitly provide urban TSLR/FMB lookup by district, town, block, ward, survey and subdivision; Kovilpatti Municipality publishes local survey-number land/asset schedules and identifies its town-planning land administration functions.
registryEvidence.localCustodianScope: Kovilpatti Municipality is evidenced as the local municipal custodian for its published municipal land and planning records; the cadastral-record service is a Tamil Nadu state land-record service. This does not prove complete citywide vector coverage.

officialSources.observation: Government Services Portal describes Tamil Nadu Patta/Chitta/FMB rural and TSLR urban lookup using town, block, ward, survey and subdivision inputs.

Tamil Nadu Government Land Management System describes integration of RoR, cadastral maps/FMB and land information; the landing page also exposes a land-parcels module, but its route was not publicly resolved anonymously.
Official Kovilpatti Municipality asset table publishes survey/TS ward/block references and municipal land extents; this is tabular municipal asset evidence, not a parcel geometry service.
Official municipality page assigns town planning responsibility for master plans, land-use areas, plan approvals, land acquisition/alienation and encroachment control.
Official TNGIS map application was discovered with public map UI and administrative/layer controls; direct retrieval timed out in this attempt and no cadastral parcel response was retained.
